# Guitar-TECHS dry electric guitar fixtures

Source audio is from [Guitar-TECHS](https://zenodo.org/records/14963133)
by Hegel Pedroza, Wallace Abreu, Ryan M. Corey, and Iran R. Roman,
released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The recordings are direct inputs. The source papers and archives also
include separate amp and microphone channels.

| Fixture | Source and edits | What to listen for |
|---|---|---|
| `pf300-palm-mutes.flac` | Player 1, Ibanez PF300, `P1_techniques.zip`, `audio/directinput/directinput_PalmMute.wav`, 0–24 s | Pick transients and muted tails through distortion, clean-to-gated transitions, and chatter during rests. |
| `pf300-major-chords.flac` | Player 1, Ibanez PF300, `P1_chords.zip`, `audio/directinput/directinput_Set1_maj.wav`, 8–24 s | Chord definition under overdrive and EQ, modulation on sustained chords, and echo decay. |
| `pf300-high-bends.flac` | Player 1, Ibanez PF300, `P1_techniques.zip`, `audio/directinput/directinput_Bendings.wav`, 160–176 s, first of two identical channels, resampled from 44.1 to 48 kHz | Fuzz gating on sustained notes, octave tracking across bends, and delay feedback on a lead part. |
| `sire-t7-performance-11.flac` | Player 3, Sire T7, `P3_music.zip`, `audio/directinput/directinput_11.wav`, entire performance, first of two identical channels | Attack and release on musical phrases, pick-driven envelope sweeps, and wet/dry balance. |

The excerpts are mono 24-bit FLAC at 48 kHz. There is no normalization or
dynamic processing. Each path in the table is
relative to the archive's top-level player directory.
